subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM **of the given word.

**Mitigate**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4) i.e. "Aggravate".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mitigate: (शमन करना) **- To make less severe, serious, or painful.

 
 
• **Example**: He wanted to mitigate misery in the world.
 
 
 
• **Aggravate: (बिगाड़ना) **- To make (a problem, injury, or offense) worse or more serious.
 
 
• **Example**: Pollution can aggravate asthma conditions.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Aggravate".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reform: (सुधारना) **- To make changes in (something, typically a social, political, or economic institution or practice) in order to improve it.
 
• **Sharpen: (तेज़ करना)** - To improve or cause to improve.
 
• **Mend: (मरम्मत करना) **- To repair something that is broken or damaged.
